chapter: Caravan, Perdido and the first tunes
title: Moon Over Cuba
summary: He wrote it in Chicago, played it for Duke, and Duke arranged and recorded it.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: I wrote that in Chicago, I think it was. I gave it to Duke to play, and I played it with him -- everything he wanted me to play on the trombone, you know, to see what it sounded like, and then he takes it and made an
arrangement of it and recorded it, which I thank him very much for. He recorded everything I did.
